description: `page_links.pages` is `anyOf(forward_links, backward_links, {})`. The converter emits a type-level union whose runtime schema is S.Unknown, so `ForwardLinks | BackwardLinks | unknown` collapses to `unknown` and consumers cannot read `links.pages.next` (the pagination output token) without a cast. Replace it with one flat object of optional URL strings — the wire carries whichever of `first`/`prev`/`next`/`last` apply to the current page.

value.smithy.api#documentation: Links to the first, previous, next and last pages of the results. Only the links that apply to the current page are present — the last page has no `next`, the first page has no `prev`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: URI of the first page of the results.
